figura.docs.living_entity.create.is_ridi:
[Create]
Returns true if this entity is riding a Chain Conveyor
figura.docs.living_entity.create.is_card:
[Create]
Returns true if this entity is in stealth using Cardboard Armor
figura.docs.renderer.create.should_skyho:
[Create]
Gets if you should play the Chain Conveyor riding animation
figura.docs.renderer.create.set_skyhook_:
[Create]
Sets if you should play the Chain Conveyor riding animation
figura.docs.renderer.create.should_cardb:
[Create]
Gets if you should hide in a box when using Cardboard Armor
figura.docs.host.hex.get_sentinel:
[Hexcasting]
Returns a list of data about your Sentinel, if it exists
This includes its position, dimension, and whether it extends your ambit or not
Returns null if not summoned
figura.docs.itemstack.hex.can_hold_media:
[Hexcasting]
Gets if the item can contain media in any capacity
figura.docs.itemstack.hex.get_media:
[Hexcasting]
Returns how much media is contained within this item, if any
figura.docs.itemstack.hex.get_max_media:
[Hexcasting]
Returns the maximum amount of media this item can contain, if any
figura.docs.itemstack.hex.can_recharge:
[Hexcasting]
Gets if this item's media reserves can be refilled
figura.docs.itemstack.hex.can_provide_me:
[Hexcasting]
Gets if this item's media can provide media to external sources
figura.docs.itemstack.hex.get_consumptio:
[Hexcasting]
Returns the priority for this media holder to be selected when casting a hex
Higher priorities are taken first
figura.docs.itemstack.hex.can_craft_batt:
[Hexcasting]
Gets if this item can be used to create a battery for media items
